meta.name: board-memo
meta.description: Draft a board or executive summary of an engagement using outcomes, risks and investment decisions. Use when the sponsor needs to brief senior leadership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目成果、风险与投入决策整理成给高层看的简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要替负责人向董事会或高层汇报进展与投入决策。
copy.tagline_en: Turn engagement outcomes, risks and budget calls into a board-ready summary
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you brief senior leadership on outcomes, risks and investment.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会依据你提供的允许上下文,起草面向董事会或高管的项目总结,内容涵盖成果、风险与投资决策;未知信息照实保留,不擅自补全。
howto.when: 当项目发起人需要向高层领导汇报时触发;若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前的净化和范围,不重跑设置或已答问题。

say.text: 帮我起草这份项目的董事会总结,写清成果、风险和投资决策。
say.note: 会基于你给的上下文直接产出备忘录草稿。

say.text: 把当前项目整理成一页高管摘要,保留未知项。
say.note: 未知信息照实保留,不擅自补全。

say.text: 这是 @fde 给的净化和范围,接着写高管汇报。
say.note: 复用现有上下文,不重跑设置和盘问。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drafts a board or executive summary of an engagement from the permitted context you supply, covering outcomes, risks and investment decisions. Unknowns are preserved rather than filled in.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the sponsor needs to brief senior leadership. If called by @fde, it reuses the current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or re-asking answered questions.

say_en.text: Draft a board summary covering outcomes, risks and investment decisions.
say_en.note: Produces a memo draft from the context you give.

say_en.text: Turn the current project into a one-page exec summary, keeping unknowns.
say_en.note: Unknowns stay marked, not filled in.

say_en.text: Here is the sanitized @fde packet and scope; continue the exec brief.
say_en.note: Reuses existing context; no setup rerun.
